title: New Optimizations
description: A simple optimization modpack with plenty of optimizations and QoL mods.
body:
# 🌿 New Optimizations

#### **New Optimizations** is a lightweight, client-side modpack focused on squeezing out the best performance from your game while adding just a touch of polish through quality-of-life.
### 💡 What’s Inside:
- ⚙️ **Optimization Mods** – Includes Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast and alot more for maximum FPS and reduced lag.
- 🎨 **Quality Of Life Enhancements** – Some upgrades like **BetterF3** and **Inventory Essentials** make the game easier to navigate in some places.
- 🧼 **Lightweight & Vanilla-Friendly** – Safe to use on vanilla servers, with no major gameplay overhauls.

### 🚀 Why Choose New Optimizations?
- Boosts FPS on low to mid-end systems  
- Keeps Minecraft looking and feeling vanilla  
- Adds smart improvements for everyday gameplay  

### Performance
- Tested with GTX 1660 Super + Ryzen 5 3600
- New Optimizations is in beta, so the preformence will not be much better than vanilla until i find better mods, but it still has a large preformence boost from vanilla

Without New Optimizations

390 - 430 FPS
![Vanilla FPS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7374a91677246b676229c33ca320fc965b9359d9.png)

With New Optimizations

410 - 505 FPS
![New Optimizations FPS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27c4194acf60ea3f8232e4b548073c18f102c4f6.png)

**Run smoother. Stay vanilla.**
